tools.name: g2x_describe_surface
tools.description: Describes the current G2X surface, its active tools, the current record when one is present, and the viewer's access. It does not inspect page content or fetch platform records.

tools.name: g2x_get_access_options
tools.description: Explains the safe next step when an agent needs more records, a gated field, help, or an approved data workflow. It does not unlock or fetch data.

need.description: The kind of additional access or guidance needed.

tools.name: g2x_get_more_data_options
tools.description: Provides the same bounded access guidance for agents that still use the earlier G2X tool name. It does not unlock or fetch data.

need.description: The kind of additional access or guidance needed.

tools.name: g2x_get_page_context
tools.description: Returns bounded metadata for the current G2X page and explains the viewer's active access contract. It never returns the page body, hidden fields, or upstream API data.

tools.name: g2x_search_companies
tools.description: Resolves a company name to linked SAM legal entities in G2X. Multiple UEIs remain explicit alternatives so the caller can choose the intended entity.

tools.name: g2x_search_intel
tools.description: Searches published intelligence from G2X analysts and returns linked, preview-only post records. It never returns article bodies or unpublished posts.

vertical.description: Optionally limit results to one G2X market.
